data.name: xrLabel5.Text
data.value: The Goods will be packed in proper export packing which should be robust enough to sustain extreme temperatures and weather conditions during voyages and storages such as rains humidity, dust storms and temperature variations.

data.name: xrLabel3.Text
data.value:
After shipment is made following original documents shall be submitted through any one of (DHL, FedEx, TNT) courier at our below mentioned office address and the copy of same by e-mail at:finance@abteurope.uk
- Signed / Stamped Commercial invoice mentioning country of origin, HS Code and our purchase order no. - Signed / Stamped Packing list. - Certificate of Origin. - Original B/L - Photographs before packing and after packing. - Quality/Mill Test Certificate. - Standard Warrantee /Guarantee Certificate

data.name: xrLabel1.Text
data.value:
Prior to shipment draft shipping documents shall be provided for our review.
No documentation of your company like commercial invoice / packing list or product Catalogue shall be included in the packing. The packing must only contain the Product Ordered.
Penalty Clause: Delay in delivery of material will cause penalty of 1% of part of delayed order value by each passing week and the same will be deducted from your balance payment.
